calculation_origin: Direct integer recomputation from each retained serial.raw; capture aggregates were read only afterward for an agreement check. Payload recurrence separately implemented with explicit u32 masks.

units.runtime: settled task-attributed wall microseconds including generation+drain+boundary work; not physical CPU utilization

formulas.accepted: completed_in_window + completed_in_drain; completed_at_or_before_cutoff counts in window
formulas.service: finish_offset - start_offset, completed subset only; gross wall span
formulas.boundary_residual: whole_phase_total - sum(task_deltas), signed and not idle

limits: One warm-reset qualification capture per profile, fixed disabled-then-enabled order on one board; no profiling-effect difference, ratio or paired estimator is defined.
Finite 250ms work pulses and an experimental 2000us completion reference do not establish sustainable capacity or a product deadline.
Both profiles retain common timestamp/record/observer work; disabled is not an uninstrumented baseline.
Accepted-only distributions exclude missed/full jobs by definition; those jobs remain counted in offered-work failures, never invented zero-latency samples.
Heap/stack-fill observations are scoped indicators, not global runtime peaks, fragmentation or application headroom.
Counter attribution is ISR-inclusive, has open-interval boundary residuals and includes drain; no physical busy/idle or exclusive ISR percentage is calculated.
No external timing or power instrument, radio experiment, SMP result or overall platform decision is supplied.
